articles.title: Sophie Adenot, the second French woman to fly to space
articles.summary:
Paris, France (AFP) Feb 13, 2026


 When she was growing up, Sophie Adenot plastered her childhood bedroom with posters of rockets launching from Cape Canaveral. 

On Friday, she blasted off from that very launchpad, fulfilling her childhood dream and becoming just the second French woman to fly to space.

articles.title: International crew arrives at space station
articles.summary:
Washington, United States (AFP) Feb 14, 2026

 Four astronauts docked at the International Space Station on Saturday for a months-long research mission, replacing a crew forced to return to Earth early over a medical issue.

articles.title: Vietnam licenses Musk's satellite internet firm Starlink
articles.summary:
Hanoi, Vietnam (AFP) Feb 15, 2026


 Vietnam has granted a licence to Elon Musk's Starlink to operate its satellite internet services in the communist country, a government agency said.
